device: cuda (sm_86; kernels JIT-compiled to a cubin and run on the device)

M1.note: measured on the low surface. Top-level counts are RTV-on (generate-runtime-verification enabled), because a detection matrix asks what the toolchain can catch and RTV is part of MLIR; `by_rtv.off` is the bare pipeline, which is the baseline S12's delta is computed against. The two modes are separate measurements and are never merged (manifest §5.1). n_injected counts INJECTIONS (spec level), not records: the whole lane's 240 mutant records reduce to 64 M1 injections.

M2.note: no expressible M2 mutant on this surface; all spec N=40 mutants => n/a. no cross-tensor shape contract exists on the memref/affine surface: shapes are already concrete buffer descriptors, so a rank/extent disagreement is not expressible (mutation-specs-v2.md 5)

M3.note: no expressible M3 mutant on this surface; all spec N=40 mutants => n/a. hardware-constraint defects have no expressible form on the plain memref/affine kernel surface: it authors no mma/tma/alignment construct, and lowering it to a device launch does not add one; launch-geometry (M3.17-M3.26) is outside this lane's M1 mandate (mutation-specs-v2.md 5, measured)

S1_class_axis.note: The per-class status this lane claims. `measured` classes have real cells in S1_detection; `n/a` classes have cells with n_na = N_TARGET_PER_CLASS; `uncompared` classes have NO cell and are listed in S1_declared_uncompared. A reader must be able to tell an unmeasured gap from a measured capability limit.

M1.miss_note: each of these ran with real sanitizer coverage (instrumented > 0) and still produced no report: the injected defect corrupts the result WITHOUT any access leaving its allocation, so no memory checker can see it. This residue — not the flagged count — is what S12 measures.

S12_method.chain: mlir-opt <bare GPU pipeline: lower-affine, then gpu-lower-to-nvvm-pipeline> | compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck --error-exitcode 99 mlir-runner
S12_method.rtv: off (RTV's own cf.assert fires on the device before the faulty access and would make memcheck silent)
S12_method.false_negative_gate: the lowered module's device launch count is recorded; 0 launches => stage=instrument and never a 'clean' verdict
S12_method.why_not_asan: the kernel runs on the device, so a natively-linked host ASan binary cannot observe the access; memcheck is the checker that shares the execution model

census.note: §5.1's enumeration arithmetic is owner-approved and must NOT be trimmed to hit N=40 exactly; the overshoot is recorded here rather than silently absorbed

scope.note: manifest.md §1 counts 15 categories; this lane composes 4.
